SELECT m.member_id memberId, m.account_id accountId, a.email_masked emailMasked, m.member_type memberType, (SELECT r.role_code FROM t_tenant_member_role g JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_member_id=m.member_id AND g.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.role_scope_key=CAST(g.tenant_id AS CHAR) AND g.effective_from <= #{now} AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to > #{now}) AND r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key AND r.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.effective_from DESC, g.tenant_member_role_id DESC LIMIT 1) roleCode, m.status, m.create_time joinedAt
WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.member_type='OWNER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.create_time, m.member_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
SELECT WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.member_id=#{memberId}
SELECT WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.account_id=#{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND a.email_vault_token=#{emailToken}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_tenant_member SET member_type=#{memberType}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE' AND member_type<>'OWNER'
UPDATE t_tenant_member SET status='REVOKED', version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE' AND member_type<>'OWNER'
mapper.select: SELECT g.tenant_member_role_id grantId, g.tenant_member_id memberId, g.tenant_id tenantId, g.role_id roleId, r.role_code roleCode, g.effective_from effectiveFrom, g.granted_by grantedBy, g.status, g.version FROM t_tenant_member_role g JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND g.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.effective_from, g.tenant_member_role_id FOR UPDATE OF g
mapper.update: UPDATE t_tenant_member_role SET status='REVOKED', effective_to=#{now}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE tenant_member_role_id=#{grantId} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT i.invitation_id invitationId, i.invited_email_masked emailMasked, r.role_code roleCode, i.status, i.expires_time expiresTime, a.email_masked invitedByEmailMasked, i.create_time createTime FROM t_tenant_invitation i JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=i.initial_role_id AND r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN t_tenant_member im ON im.member_id=i.invited_by_member_id AND im.tenant_id=i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN t_user_account a ON a.account_id=im.account_id
ORDER BY i.create_time DESC, i.invitation_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.update: UPDATE t_tenant_invitation SET status='EXPIRED', active_slot=NULL, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE invitation_id=#{invitationId} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_time <= #{now}
UPDATE t_tenant_invitation SET expires_time=#{expiresTime}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE invitation_id=#{invitationId} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING' AND active_slot=1
UPDATE t_tenant_invitation SET status='REVOKED', active_slot=NULL, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE invitation_id=#{invitationId} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_authentication_challenge (challenge_id, challenge_no, realm, purpose, account_id, tenant_invitation_id, email_vault_token, email_masked, active_scope_hash, secret_hmac, hmac_key_version, expires_time, max_attempts, used_attempts, status, active_slot, consumed_time, supersedes_challenge_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{challenge.id}, #{challenge.challengeNo}, 'CUSTOMER', 'TENANT_INVITATION_ACCEPT', NULL, #{challenge.invitationId}, #{challenge.emailToken}, #{challenge.emailMasked}, #{challenge.scopeHash}, #{challenge.secretHmac}, #{challenge.keyVersion}, #{challenge.expiresTime}, 5, 0, 'PENDING', 1, NULL, #{challenge.supersedesId}, 1, #{challenge.createTime}, #{challenge.createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_authentication_challenge SET status=CASE WHEN expires_time<=#{now} THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN used_attempts+1>=max_attempts THEN 'REVOKED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, active_slot=CASE WHEN expires_time<=#{now} OR used_attempts+1>=max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE 1 END, used_attempts=LEAST(used_attempts+1,max_attempts), version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE challenge_id=#{challengeId} AND AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING' AND active_slot=1
